logp.method_description: The water/n-octanol distribution coefficients were determined by the stir-flask method [39], [40]. Solutions of water-saturated octanol and octanol-saturated water were prepared by shaking equal volumes of octanol and water for one week and allowing the mixture to separate into the respective phases. An UV–Vis calibration curve was prepared for each complex in octanol-saturated water in a range 2–50 μM. A mixture of 10 mL n-octanol and 10 mL water (each saturated in the other) was stirred for 2 h at 37 °C, after adding the sample to be analyzed. The pH was maintained at 7.2 (5 mM Trizma-HCl). Once equilibrium was reached, the organic and aqueous phases were separated and centrifuged. Finally, the drug concentration in each phase was measured spectrophotometrically to determine values for P, [drug in octanol]/[drug in water]. Experiments were carried out three times [41] and the results expressed as Log P.
